title: Collaborative workflow projection values and projector checkpoint
description: Newly authored Storage owner contract under DL-090: SP-460 to SP-478 in Plans/storage-plan.md, backed by reports/event-authority-20261104/DC-binding-search.md. The closed values of the seven collaboration projection key shapes and of the projector checkpoint. Values hold IDs, refs, hashes, enums, integers and timestamps only, never message, proposal, vote, finding, waiver or definition text.

non_secret_ref.description: CV-353 rule 6: a reference of the form kind:value. The kind is lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter; the whole reference has at most 256 characters and no whitespace. It names an object, grants no access and holds no credential, account identifier, local absolute path or content.

scope_partition.description: Storage's scope_partition: exactly app for application scope, project~{base64url_no_pad(UTF8(project_id))} for project scope.

durable_read_token.description: SP-278's nine-field durable read token (DL-076), copied by value from Plans/coordination_projection_contracts.schema.json#/$defs/durable_read_token, which projects Plans/event_record_index_checkpoint.schema.json#/$defs/read_token without redb_snapshot_id; the checker compares the copy.

checkpoint_core.description: A checkpoint publication without its retired generations; a retired core is always withdrawn.

checkpoint.description: The value at projector.checkpoint.collaboration:{scope_partition} in redb's checkpoints table: pm.storage_value.collaboration_projector_checkpoint.v1@1.0.0 (SP-460). It explicitly adopts SP-278's generic EventRecord index checkpoint and stores the nine-field durable read token, never redb_snapshot_id (DL-076). One checkpoint per scope partition: app, or one per Project. admitted_event_types is the sorted exact list of collaborative workflow event types admitted in the registry when this publication was built. The same-key generation set is the current core plus at most two retired cores (RP-PROJECTION-3GEN).

proposal_projection.description: BrainStorm proposal row collaboration_proposal_projection.v1:{scope_partition}:{hex(collaboration_run_id)}:{hex(proposal_id)} (SP-460); tallies count only counted votes.
